amendment: User-authorized operational amendment after initial pass began; not a preregistered retry policy.
authorization_scope: After every one of the 18000 original API jobs has an initial attempt and every initial service has stopped: only original exact Jev image-processing HTTP503 failures may receive up to two additional attempts; the original 21 audited interrupted requests may each receive one additional attempt.
circuit_observations: All observed HTTP responses per route, including frozen initial history; interrupted journals with no observed HTTP status are excluded. Breakers persist across segments and routes cannot dilute each other.
invalid_or_partial_recovery_response: Retain once and never replay; continue independent jobs when billing is known and the original runner fatal check is false.
deepseek_billed_no_answer_exhaustions: Retain missing with actual billed cost; never retry.
interruption_followed_by_503: Consumes its only additional attempt; does not acquire the two-attempt Jev allowance.
immutable_allowlist: Created only after all initial gates pass; binds original phase plan IDs and hashes, all original request/response receipts and status snapshot, exact source history, sequence limits, policy hash, and current helper source hashes. Run requires its separately recorded SHA256.
liability: Every attempt in both original phases remains counted. Known bills retain actual per-attempt prices. Every unknown bill reserves the full frozen context/output amount. Admit one additional attempt only if existing liability plus its full reserve stays within the original shared route cap.
frozen_contract: Same image, payload, prompt, route, exact model and runtime; original journals and summaries remain unchanged.
selection: Receipt error classes alone determine eligibility. No favorable score, label, category, source or partition selection.
service_gate: Require every initial user unit inactive or failed, MainPID 0, no surviving processes in any present unit cgroup, and exclusive ownership of all four original route locks.
lite_gate: Independent Lite work is not part of the 18000 API-job completion gate.
crash_before_request_journal: An admission metadata file without a request journal requires audit; do not overwrite or silently reuse it.
